articles.headline: Thierno Barry, Everton's last striker standing, begins to silence doubters
articles.description: Given that Thierno Barry essentially finds himself Everton's only centre-forward option after a muddled end to the transfer window, he probably doesn't care too much how the goals come at the moment.
articles.headlineJa: エヴァートンに残された唯一のストライカー、ティエルノ・バリが懐疑派を黙らせ始める
articles.descriptionJa: 混乱を極めた移籍市場の終盤を経て、ティエルノ・バリは実質的にエヴァートン唯一のセンターフォワードとなった。今の彼にとっては、どのようにゴールが生まれるかはそれほど重要ではないだろう。
articles.body:
Given that Thierno Barry essentially finds himself Everton's only centre-forward option after a muddled end to the transfer window, he probably doesn't care too much how the goals come at the moment.

Eleven minutes into Saturday's Premier League meeting with Ipswich Town, defender James Tarkowski took aim from distance, only for his volley to appear to be heading wide of goal.

Barry, finding himself in the path of Tarko's fierce first-time effort, reacted quickly, adjusted his body, and diverted the ball beyond Christian Walton and into the Ipswich net with his upper thigh.

It wasn't a particularly glorious or a refined finish, but Barry's shunt of his hips was enough to send Everton past the Tractor Boys 1-0, extending their unbeaten run and moving them into seventh for the elongated international break.

This was Barry's second league goal of the season, and his fifth in all competitions, but it's surely his most important, given how things have changed for Everton since late August.

While Everton may be broadly pleased with their squad-building efforts over the transfer window -- the late arrival of Ainsley Maitland-Niles looks to have immediately solved their problem rightback position -- the late confusion about the striking options had threatened to leave them utterly toothless this term.

Heading towards the end of the transfer window, Barry had appeared set to be vying for minutes and the opportunity to establish himself as the Toffees' line-leader with Guinea-Bissau striker Beto, with the pair having shared duties, neither convincingly, last term.

David Moyes clearly wasn't happy, however, and explored a £35 million deal to bring Richarlison back to the club from Tottenham, only for the deal to collapse after the Brazil international could not agree personal terms.

Beto was nonetheless allowed to leave to join Fiorentina, with Everton then expecting that USA international Folarin Balogun would come in to solve the problem. A deal worth approximately £40 million was agreed with Monaco, only for an issue flagged during the striker's medical to complicate proceedings.

The clubs renegotiated, a deal sheet was submitted, there was broad confidence that Everton would get their man, only for Balogun to have second thoughts and walk away from the move.

There was late, late talk of Joshua Zirkzee from Manchester United or Aston Villa's Tammy Abraham, although neither deal materialised, and the window closed.

It's hard to see it as anything other than a calamitous bungle; after all of Moyes' calls for greater depth and quality across his squad, Everton were emerging from deadline day with only one recognised striker: Barry.

And understandably, this didn't fill Everton fans with confidence, after a debut season in England in which the 23-year-old showed glimpses of his quality... but only scored eight league goals in 38 outings.

articles.headline: Is it time for Liverpool to give up on Florian Wirtz already? Or is he a superstar-in-progress?
articles.description: Liverpool spent a then-club record fee to sign Florian Wirtz, but his low stats have many writing him off. Is it too soon, or should Liverpool move on?
articles.headlineJa: リヴァプールはもうフロリアン・ヴィルツを諦めるべきか？ それとも成長途上のスーパースターか？
articles.descriptionJa: リヴァプールは当時のクラブ記録となる移籍金を投じてフロリアン・ヴィルツを獲得したが、数字の低さから見切りをつける人も多い。諦めるにはまだ早すぎるのか、それともリヴァプールは前へ進むべきなのだろうか？
articles.body:
You can't defend him. He's the full package. He's world class. He loves to play. He's an outstanding technician. He's a huge asset with a carefree nature. He's mature of mind. He's one of the top players in the world.

This is just a sampling of what a handful of top managers said about Florian Wirtz -- before he moved to Liverpool.

The promise was, essentially, a perfect playmaker: someone who was equally adept at finding space without the ball between the lines and breaking the opposition apart once he got possession.

He could dribble past you or split the defense open with a through ball. He could tee a teammate up for a tap-in or blast a shot past the goalkeeper. And he could do it all without requiring any trade-offs elsewhere. Unlike luxury playmakers of previous generations, he worked just as hard to win games with the ball as he did to win the ball back.

This is why Liverpool spent a then-club record €117.5 million ($133 million) last summer for a player not already in the Premier League. For someone with such a diverse set of skills, the floor is incredibly high. Not everything needs to click for him to still provide value somewhere.

But the ceiling was just as high. Wirtz was the best player in the Bundesliga as a 20-year-old. Not only could he become the best player in the Premier League -- he could become the best player in the world. Wherever his career went, this much seemed to be true: drop Florian Wirtz into your lineup, and he'd help your team win.

But then, almost as soon as Wirtz arrived in England, Liverpool started losing: 12 times, in fact, after just four defeats the season prior. It was the club's most Premier League losses in over a decade. The Reds followed up their 84-point title-winning season with a 24-point decline. They finished last season closer to the relegation places on points than to winning the title.

And who else to blame but the guy with just five goals and three assists since he joined from Bayer Leverkusen? Well, first there was the manager, Arne Slot, but Liverpool fired him. And then there was the sudden decline of superstar Mohamed Salah, but Liverpool agreed to terminate his contract.

Now, with just a solitary assist to his name this season for a team with a stuttering attack, Wirtz's struggles have become the easiest explanation for Liverpool's inexplicable decline. The fanbase is divided, former players want him dropped, and barely-sourced transfer rumors have started to chase the scent.

Florian Wirtz feels like a failure, but is it really time for Liverpool to give up?

Who was Florian Wirtz at Leverkusen?

Sure, managers Hansi Flick and Xabi Alonso say he's good at everything, but what does that really mean? How did Wirtz play at Leverkusen? And maybe more importantly, who did he play like?

articles.headline: Soccer's wildest warmup kits of 2026-27: The good, the bad and the ugly
articles.description: Forget home, away and third alternate jerseys -- the prematch warmup kit is where the real fun is to be had. Get a load of this season's best and worst.
articles.headlineJa: 2026-27シーズン サッカー界の最も斬新なウォーミングアップキット：最高、最悪、そして奇抜なデザイン
articles.descriptionJa: ホーム、アウェイ、サードユニフォームのことは忘れましょう。本当の楽しさは試合前のウォーミングアップキットにあります。今シーズンのベストとワーストをご覧ください。
articles.body:
With the 2026-27 season now underway across Europe's big leagues, we've had the chance to see teams limbering up in their new array of warmup apparel.

Predominantly worn by players while milling around on the pitch before kick-off, the designated "prematch" shirt has become a staple of the range in recent years. Many clubs put increasing amounts of effort and care into crafting said jerseys and even creating multiple variations or colorways that compliment their latest home and away kits.

Now that all of the big clubs have been in action for a few weeks, we've had the chance to peruse their respective prematch offerings and run a fashion-conscious eye over them -- whether they be good, bad, or indeed, irredeemably ugly.

- Premier League 2026-27 kits: Ranking every jersey released

- Bayern Munich's 2026-27 Oktoberfest kit is their wildest yet!

- Man City, Puma equip fans with AI to design 2026-27 third kit

THE GOOD

Barcelona

Barcelona have a lovely set of home and away variants for their prematch garb this season. The former is a rather appealing reworking of their famous Blaugrana club colours into a chic checkerboard design. Much like their Kobe Bryant collab "Mamba mentality" away kit, the alternate prematch jersey is a purple nebula design that comes with matching metallic logos and matte gold trim. Very Cyberpunk, much like Gavi's neon pink hair.

Manchester United

The red rose of Lancashire takes centre stage on Manchester United's warmup top this season, with multiple silhouetted graphics of the symbolic flower being picked out in red against a black backdrop. Possibly just one rose blooming around the club crest might have produced a  more streamlined effect, but it's a smart effort nevertheless.

Liverpool

Liverpool have used the very same "LFC" pattern found on their new 2026-27 away kit to add texture to the all-red home version of their new pre-match shirts. The motif is inspired by printed decoration found on vintage Anfield tickets stubs from the 1970s and 80s and really helps to elevate the design.

Real Madrid

Real Madrid have implemented the same rosy pink and bottle green colour combo across all of their home, away and third kits this campaign, with the prematch shirt sharing the same palette. The simple, smart retro design comes complete with raglan sleeves, a V-neck collar, Adidas trefoil logo and the club's initials ("RMCF") printed across the back of the shoulders.

Paris Saint-Germain

PSG's standard livery is melded in such a way as to create an eye-catching melange of neon purple hues thanks to the optical illusion created by the narrow pinstripes and the swirling gradients of red and blue in the background. There's also an oversized PSG crest slapped bang in the centre for good measure -- but still the design feels cool and dynamic rather than cluttered.

AS Roma

articles.descriptionJa: リヴァプールはフェイエノールトの右サイドバック、ヒバイロ・リードを注視しているが、アーセナルやマンチェスター・シティとの争奪戦に直面している。『Transfer Talk』が最新情報をお伝えする。
articles.body:
Feyenoord right back Givairo Read has caught the eye of Liverpool, Arsenal and Manchester City, while Manchester United are monitoring Borussia Dortmund striker Serhou Guirassy and Vålerenga's 15-year-old winger Gabriel Rajkovic. Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Trending rumors

- Liverpool are monitoring Feyenoord right back Givairo Read, but face competition from Arsenal and Manchester City, according to TEAMtalk. The 20-year-old Netherlands U21 international has registered four assists in seven Eredivisie appearances this season, with all three clubs continuing to track his progress following summer interest. A January move remains an option depending on formal approaches, after Nottingham Forest and AS Roma previously submitted offers of around €20 million that came to nothing.

- Manchester United are monitoring Borussia Dortmund striker Serhou Guirassy as they assess attacking options ahead of January, TEAMtalk reports. The 30-year-old is being considered as an experienced option should Joshua Zirkzee depart, while United remain committed to Benjamin Šeško despite his recent injury issues. Dortmund are reluctant to let Guirassy leave, but his contract has than two years remaining, which could force their hand. Meanwhile, The Sun reports that United are targeting Vålerenga's 15-year-old winger Gabriel Rajkovic as a replacement for JJ Gabriel. 

- Barcelona are monitoring Athletico Paranaense center back Arthur Dias, as per Mundo Deportivo. Barca's head of scouting, João Amaral, reportedly watched the 19-year-old against Bahia, with Tottenham Hotspur, Newcastle United and Atlético Madrid also among his admirers. The left-footed defender, who earned a call-up to Carlo Ancelotti's Brazil squad, has a transfer value of around €30 million and after Spurs previously had a €21 million offer for 80% of his economic rights rejected.

- Tottenham Hotspur will not pursue a move for free-agent Mauro Icardi, Football Insider has revealed. The 33-year-old striker has been available since leaving Galatasaray in July, but Spurs are wary of his wage demands and lack of Premier League experience. Serie A is considered the likeliest destination for the former Sampdoria, Inter Milan and PSG star, with Lazio among several interested Italian clubs.

- Roma are interested in signing free-agent Raphaël Guerreiro, according to Tuttomercatoweb. The 32-year-old Portugal international left back has re-emerged as an option for manager Gian Piero Gasperini as a natural left-footed alternative on the flank, while Olympiacos are also interested in the former Bayern Munich defender.

articles.headline: Aaron Donald's return fires up Rams in rout of Giants
articles.description: Aaron Donald -- and the SoFi Stadium crowd's response to him -- sparked the Rams in his first game since the end of the 2023 season.
articles.headlineJa: アーロン・ドナルドの復帰がラムズを鼓舞、ジャイアンツに大勝
articles.descriptionJa: 2023年シーズン終了以来の出場となったアーロン・ドナルドと、彼に対するSoFiスタジアムの観客の熱狂が、復帰戦でラムズに大きな勢いをもたらした。
articles.body:
INGLEWOOD, Calif. -- When Aaron Donald ran out onto the field for his first game since the end of the 2023 season, the SoFi Stadium crowd erupted.

The Los Angeles Rams defensive tackle, who was playing in his first game back since coming out of retirement on Aug. 30, said he "did a little bit more jumping than I used to do" on his run out of the tunnel before the 28-6 win against the New York Giants.

Donald called it "special" to be embraced the way he was in his return.

"If you didn't get chills when he was introduced, then you're not freaking alive," Rams coach Sean McVay said.

Donald's presence also affected his teammates. Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford said he was "so juiced" after watching Donald run out of the tunnel, "I couldn't control myself."

"The fans were happy to see him back, and we all were, too," Stafford said.

Donald finished the game with three tackles, a tackle for a loss and zero pressures, according to Next Gen Stats. He played 32 (58.2%) of the Rams' defensive snaps. Asked whether Donald was on a snap count, McVay said, "What do you think?"

"You tell him to come out," McVay joked.

Donald said afterward that he was "a little sore right now." He had a wrap on his right hand during his postgame news conference, but when asked about it, he said his hand was "just a little sore."

"Two panicked practices and then a game," Donald said.

He said he felt a little rust during the game but that things slowed down for him toward the second half.

Though Donald did not have a pressure, the Rams had a 66.7% pass rush win rate against the Giants, meaning they beat their block within 2.5 seconds on two-thirds of their rushes. According to ESPN Analytics/NFL Next Gen Stats, that was tied for the third best by any team in Week 2 and is the team's highest rate in any game since Week 11 of the 2022 season.

That mark comes a week after the team had a pass rush win rate of 35% in Week 1, which was the sixth-lowest mark in the NFL that week.

"He elicits attention," McVay said. "He brings everybody up around him. And I didn't think it was by coincidence that the energy that we played with [tonight]. I thought really the defensive coaches did a great job with their game plan, but ultimately just elevating situations he's in and people that he's around and that's what the greats do and that's what he does."

Though McVay pointed to Donald's energy as a difference-maker against the Giants, he also pointed to another big reason the Rams had better energy and execution in Week 2 than they did in their Week 1 loss to the San Francisco 49ers.

"Sometimes you win, sometimes you learn," McVay said. "And sometimes you have a dumbass coach that makes travel plans that put you in a bad spot."
articles.bodyJa:
カリフォルニア州イングルウッド -- アーロン・ドナルドが2023年シーズン終了以来初めてフィールドに駆け出すと、SoFiスタジアムの大歓声が沸き起こった。

8月30日に現役復帰を果たしてから初の試合に臨んだロサンゼルス・ラムズのディフェンシブタックルは、ニューヨーク・ジャイアンツに28-6で勝利したこの試合の前、トンネルから走って出るときに「以前よりも少し余計にジャンプした」と明かした。

ドナルドは、復帰にあたりこのように歓迎されたことを「特別なこと」と表現した。

「彼が紹介されたときに鳥肌が立たなかったとしたら、生きてるとは言えないよ」とラムズのショーン・マクベイ監督は語った。

ドナルドの存在はチームメイトにも影響を与えた。ラムズのクォーターバック、マシュー・スタッフロードは、ドナルドがトンネルから飛び出す姿を見て「とても興奮して自分を抑えきれなかった」と語った。

「ファンは彼の復帰を喜んでいたし、僕たち全員もそうだった」とスタッフロードは話した。

Next Gen Statsによると、ドナルドは3タックル、1TFL（タックル・フォー・ロス）、0プレッシャーで試合を終えた。彼はラムズのディフェンススナップの58.2％にあたる32スナップに出場した。ドナルドにスナップ数の制限があったかと問われたマクベイ監督は、「どう思う？」と返した。

「彼にベンチへ下がれと言ってみてよ」とマクベイ監督はジョークを飛ばした。

試合後、ドナルドは「今は少し体が痛い」と話した。試合後の記者会見では右手の上に包帯を巻いていたが、それについて聞かれると、手は「ただ少し痛むだけ」と答えた。

「焦ってやった2回の練習と、それから試合だったからね」とドナルドは語った。

彼は試合中に少し動きの鈍さを感じたと明かしたが、後半に向けて落ち着いてきたという。

ドナルドのプレッシャーはゼロだったものの、ラムズはジャイアンツに対して66.7%のパスラッシュ勝利割合（2.5秒以内にブロックを突破した割合）を記録した。ESPN Analytics/NFL Next Gen Statsによると、これは第2週の全チームの中で3位タイであり、チームとしては2022年シーズン第11週以来の最高数値となった。

この記録は、第1週のパスラッシュ勝利割合がNFLで6番目に低い35%だったことからの大きな改善である。

「彼は注目を集めるんだ」とマクベイ監督は語った。「周囲の誰もを引き上げる。（今夜の）チームのプレーのエネルギーが彼のおかげだったのは偶然ではないと思う。ディフェンスのコーチ陣も素晴らしいゲームプランを用意してくれたが、彼自身の存在と彼が周りに与える影響が局面を高めてくれる。それこそが偉大な選手がすることであり、彼がやってのけることなんだ」

マクベイ監督はドナルドのエナジーがジャイアンツ戦の勝因の一つだと指摘したが、サンフランシスコ・フォーティナイナーズに敗れた第1週よりも、第2週でラムズのエナジーと遂行力が向上したもう一つの大きな理由についても言及した。

「勝つこともあれば、学ぶこともある」とマクベイ監督は語った。「そして、移動の計画ミスでチームを厳しい状況に追い込むようなマヌケな監督がいることもあるんだ」

articles.headlineJa: 2026年MLB ABSチャレンジシステムトラッカー：チーム・選手ランキング
articles.descriptionJa: ABSチャレンジシステムのリーダーボードでは、MLBシーズンを通じて打者、捕手、チーム、審判をランキング付けします。
articles.body:
Major League Baseball implemented the ABS challenge system for the 2026 season, which allows players to challenge a ball or strike call made by the plate umpire. Each team receives two challenges to start the game, and only batters, pitchers and catchers can challenge a call. If a team wins a challenge, it can keep challenging. If a team challenges incorrectly twice, it loses its challenges for the rest of the game.

Here are the ABS challenge system rankings for batters, catchers, teams and umpires for the 2026 MLB season.

Data updated through Monday, September 21.

articles.headline: Drew Gilbert's homer and 2-run single lead Giants past Twins 5-2 to end 3-game losing streak
articles.description: — Drew Gilbert homered and hit a two-run single, leading the San Francisco Giants past the Minnesota Twins 5-2 on Monday night to snap a three-game losing streak.
articles.headlineJa: ドリュー・ギルバートの本塁打と2点適時打でジャイアンツがツインズを5-2で破り、連敗を3でストップ
articles.descriptionJa: ドリュー・ギルバートが本塁打と2点タイムリーヒットを放ち、サンフランシスコ・ジャイアンツが月曜夜の試合でミネソタ・ツインズを5-2で下して3連敗を阻止しました。
articles.body:
SAN FRANCISCO -- — Drew Gilbert homered and hit a two-run single, leading the San Francisco Giants past the Minnesota Twins 5-2 on Monday night to snap a three-game losing streak.


              Brett Harris singled in a pair of runs for San Francisco in the first inning and Gilbert did the same in the second before leading off the fifth with his 11th homer.


              Brooks Lee homered to begin the fourth against Giants starter Blade Tidwell, who exited after one more batter because of elbow discomfort. He will undergo tests Tuesday. 


              Tidwell was coming off his first win with the Giants and second of his career last time out at St. Louis.


              Tristan Beck (1-0) relieved and pitched 2 2/3 scoreless innings for the win. Trent Harris worked the ninth for his second save.


              Bo Davidson had his first career hit and stolen base in the first — becoming the first Giants player to get a hit and steal a base in his major league debut since Red Tramback on Sept. 15, 1940. 


              The Giants opened their season-ending homestand, which concludes against the rival Los Angeles Dodgers this weekend, with their third victory in 10 games. They were swept by the two-time defending World Series champion Dodgers last weekend in Los Angeles.


              Emmanuel Rodríguez homered in the eighth for the Twins.


              Minnesota right-hander Zebby Matthews (9-11) struck out nine — his second-most this season behind 10 on July 31 at Seattle — and didn't walk a batter. He allowed five runs and eight hits over five innings.


              Up next
              Twins RHP Taj Bradley (11-6, 3.81 ERA) pitches the middle game of the series Tuesday night opposite Giants RHP Anthony Molina (3-1, 4.18).


              ------


              
                See AP’s full MLB coverage here
articles.bodyJa:
サンフランシスコ -- ドリュー・ギルバートが本塁打と2点タイムリーヒットを放ち、サンフランシスコ・ジャイアンツが月曜夜にミネソタ・ツインズを5-2で破り、連敗を3で止めた。

サンフランシスコは初回にブレット・ハリスのタイムリーで2点を先制。2回にはギルバートが同様に2点タイムリーを放ち、5回には先頭打者として11号ソロ本塁打を放った。

ツインズは4回、ブルックス・リーの本塁打でジャイアンツの先発ブレイド・ティドウェルから得点した。ティドウェルはその後打者1人を抑えたところで肘の違和感を訴えて降板した。彼は火曜日に検査を受ける予定である。

ティドウェルは前回のセントルイス戦でジャイアンツ移籍後初勝利、キャリア通算2勝目を挙げたばかりだった。

救援したトリスタン・ベック（1勝0敗）が2回2/3を無失点に抑えて勝利投手となり、トレント・ハリスが9回を締めて今季2セーブ目を挙げた。

ボー・ダビッドソンは初回にキャリア初安打と初盗塁を記録。ジャイアンツの選手がメジャーデビュー戦で安打と盗塁を記録したのは、1940年9月15日のレッド・トラムバック以来となった。

今季最後となるホーム連戦（今週末の宿敵ロサンゼルス・ドジャース戦で終了）の初戦を迎えたジャイアンツは、直近10試合で3勝目を挙げた。先週末はロサンゼルスでワールドシリーズ2連覇中のドジャースにスイープされていた。

ツインズは8回にエマニュエル・ロドリゲスが本塁打を放った。

ミネソタの右腕ゼビー・マシューズ（9勝11敗）は、7月31日のシアトル戦での10個に次ぐ今季2番目に多い9三振を奪い、無四球と好投したものの、5回を投げて5失点、8安打を許した。

次の一戦
ツインズの右腕タジ・ブラッドリー（11勝6敗、防御率3.81）が火曜夜のシリーズ第2戦に先発し、ジャイアンツの右腕アンソニー・モリーナ（3勝1敗、防御率4.18）と対戦する。

------
